credit_line: Gift of The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts
description: One Red Book consisting of Twenty One (21) Photographs with the Prefix F109.  Inventory Numbers: F109.00001 through F109.00021. (SEE MEDIA, MEASUREMENTS FOR INVENTORY).  Film Dates Dec-71. Media: Polacolor Type 108. Warhol's Little Red Books, consisting of myriad Polaroid photographs taken by Warhol and assembled by him into in a little red photo album. These works depict a wide array of subject, including many of the artist's well-known friends and associates.
title: Little Red Book, Prefix F109
